# External dependencies of FuguSeed. scripts/deps installs each line.
# gitleaks publishes no OpenBSD build, and the ports tree holds no
# port for it. An operator on OpenBSD installs it by hand, and the
# secret gate of CI runs on Linux. signify(1) sits in base, so the
# signify tier of the runtime entry needs no package.
#
# The runtime dist entry is the Fugu library that fuguseed-words
# builds on (D-06). bin/fuguseed-qr and every module that it loads
# run on core perl, with no dependency (QR-PROGRAM-5, D-07).

runtime dist https://github.com/FuguBSD/Fugu/releases/latest/download/Fugu.tar.gz

test pkg p5-Perl-Critic
test pkg p5-Perl-Tidy
